description: Two units whose lossless component ends inside the channel set sub-header.
findings: ends inside the channel set 1 sub-header

skip.ffprobe_bitrate: ffmpeg's lossless decoder sets the bit rate to 0 (dca_xll.c: avctx->bit_rate = 0), so ffprobe lists none
skip.ffprobe_profile: ffmpeg names the lossless profile when its decoder has decoded a frame (dca_xll.c), which it does not here, so ffprobe names the core's
skip.decode: ffmpeg's decoder checks the CRC-16 of the sub-header and of the navigation index over the cut component (dca_xll.c), which fails
